name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code (https://code.claude.com/docs) as a member of this collection's ecosystem: installs the sha256-verified native release binary at /usr/local/bin/claude (no Node.js, version pinnable) unless a claude is already in the image - e.g. from the official ghcr.io/anthropics/devcontainer-features/claude-code, which is then augmented instead of replaced - and adds agent-adapter-claude (Claude Code's adapter for the agents Feature: task agents -- <name> finds a session by its name and folder and acts on it by id), the deprecated claude-host launcher, claude-fleet command and claude-host-pin hook (still working, each printing one deprecation line; claude-code 2.0 removes them), a named volume mounted at CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (/var/lib/devcontainer-features/claude-code) so login and sessions survive rebuilds, a post-create hook that makes that directory usable by the remote user, and the Feature Taskfile. The in-app auto-updater is off; a rebuild updates.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

install.description: How the claude binary gets there. 'auto': keep a claude already in the image (official Feature, base image) and only add the ecosystem pieces, else install the native binary. 'native': always install the verified native binary at /usr/local/bin/claude (wins over an npm install on PATH). 'none': never install the binary, only the pieces.

additionalDirectories.description: Comma-separated folders every Claude session in the container may read and edit besides the one it starts in (Claude Code's permissions.additionalDirectories), written at build time to the managed-settings drop-in /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.d/50-devcontainer-features-claude-code.json, so no wrapper adding --add-dir is needed and the user's own settings are not touched. Absolute paths, or ~/... for the remote user's home (expanded at build time); a relative path fails the build. Empty: nothing is written. File access only: unlike --add-dir, a folder listed here does not load its CLAUDE.md, skills or other .claude/ configuration.

remoteControl.description: Start every Claude agent the agents Feature runs with Remote Control on (--remote-control), so agents.yml need not repeat it in each agent's args. Applied by agent-adapter-claude to the sessions it starts or wakes, unless an agent's args already have --remote-control or --no-remote-control (the adapter's own per-agent opt-out). Per run: AGENT_ADAPTER_CLAUDE_REMOTE_CONTROL=0 or 1.

version.description: Native binary version to install (e.g. '2.1.286'), or a release channel: 'stable' or 'latest'. Ignored when an existing claude is kept (install=auto) or install=none.
